body.summary: Built and ran a proof-gated semantic absorption pass over the Run1-7 estate, then executed converge_estate.py apply. Discovery: the 4.0 GB of CapitalGym/run6/workspaces is 18 git checkouts of live public/owned remotes plus 3 clean staging clones; it contains only 7.17 MB of non-reproducible content (local-only commits, stashes, uncommitted diffs, untracked files). absorb_run6_estate.py captured every such byte into a content-addressed gzip freeze store at ~/.bonfyre/freeze/run8 (27 blobs, 4.4 MB total) and the 3 unique commits from the live-repo clone were absorbed into real git refs under refs/absorbed/run6/system-experiments-bonfyre/ (b22e4ce5, 2019af57) so they live in the repo object store rather than only in a tarball. verify_absorption.py re-hashed every blob, required a captured patch for every local-only commit and stash, rejected any skipped untracked file, and confirmed all 21 git remotes still resolve; it is re-run at promotion time so a stale receipt cannot authorise a delete. Only then were 3 entries promoted BLOCK->DELETE in convergence/plan.json with preservation_receipt paths. apply deleted 8 entries totalling 3,134,361,029 bytes (2.919 GiB) with zero refusals, writing DeletionProof JSON plus gzip per-file manifests; all 146,809 manifest lines match their recorded file_count and each root_digest_sha256 is recorded. Free space went 2.8 -> 6.5 GiB, clearing the pressure that killed the previous run. Two deletions were deliberately NOT taken, with evidence: the 589 MB of Bonfyre_V3_Part06-12 raw archives are a forensic chat corpus and a 3-part split archive whose members have no live copy (0/112 sampled members byte-identical to anything under ~, ~/.codex or ~/.claude), so they are the only copy of unique evidence; and .run6 is held as the parallel Codex lane's live ABSORB input for 4 MB of zero disk relief, though its byte-exact freeze is already banked. Adjacent finding: the README knight/Bonfyre branding fence fails - asset 7785a8d6-6e28-4892-8958-3daf85414f05 has never existed in this repo's README.md history, and the intended replacement is the un-absorbed Downloads/README_BONFYRE_CURRENT.md, which passes the fence exactly as written.
